outline: The purpose of the course is for students to learn about theories and research methods of cognitive human factors, and to learn how to apply these theories and methods for investigating and solving practical problems, and improving overall system performance.
schedule:
Week 01: Introduction
Week 02: Module 1-Lecture: Cognitive ergonomics
Week 03: Module 1-Lecture: Axiomatic design
Week 04: No class
Week 05: Module 2-Mental workload: Lecture
Week 06: Module 2-Mental workload: Paper reading & discussion
Week 07: Module 2-Mental workload: Practice & presentation
Week 08: No class
Week 09: Module 3-Situation awareness: Lecture
Week 10: No class
Week 11: Module 3-Situation awareness: Paper reading & discussion
Week 12: Module 3-Situation awareness: Practice & presentation
Week 13: Module 4-Mental model/Card sorting: Lecture
Week 14: Module 4-Mental model/Card sorting: Paper reading & discussion
Week 15: Module 4-Mental model/Card sorting: Practice & presentation
Week 16: Module 5-User experience/Usability testing: Lecture

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: Module 5-User experience/Usability testing: (1)Paper reading & discussion; (2) Practice & report
flexible_learning.outcome: Submitting a team report of no more than 10 pages in PowerPoint format through the class network.

assessment:
Paper reading & discussion: 30% (10% each)
Practice & presentation: 30% (10% each)
Team report of flexible learning: 20%
Participation: 20%
